name: comp-210
blurb: Disabled select field that cannot be changed.
description: A shadcn Select component with the disabled prop set, preventing user interaction while showing the current value.
use_when: A field should be visible but uneditable, such as a readonly view of data.
avoid_when: When you need the field to be interactive or when you want to hide unavailable options.
a11y: Properly marked as disabled; screen readers announce the disabled state.
